description: Jan 14 Bamako caravan is body-confirmed and tear-gas dispersal is reported, but attendance is unnumbered and the stated purpose was welcoming a traveler, with no demand on Mali’s government identified. The underlying article is credited to L’Essor.
required_followup: Independent contemporary account identifying purpose/target and simultaneous crowd count; do not treat same-day state commemoration as proof this was anti-state.

description: Jan 30 Sénou street demonstration is confirmed by Mali24; no count or physical ending is provided. Mali Actu search result describes a student delegation after Jan 26 teacher arrests, but exact body retrieval returned a tool restriction. Relation to the Jan 30 event is uncertain.
required_followup: Independent accessible reporting with attendance at one time, physical end and chronology of any Jan 26 student action. No retry or URL variant for blocked Mali Actu story.

description: Studio Tamani reports local-authority teachers in Bamako stopped work Jan 31 over salary arrears but does not describe public assembly or direct addressee.
required_followup: Independent report of any associated public demonstration, place, target, participant count and duration.

description: Mali Actu exact URL returned tool text “Failed to fetch restricted URL”; no HTTP status or publisher-side denial was exposed. The source remains exact-URL blocked only. Its search result may describe a student delegation on an earlier date; no body evidence is used. A later distinct Bambara-oriented search surfaced an amp URL variant of the same Mali Actu story; it was not opened and does not provide independent confirmation.
required_followup: Do not retry or open a variant of this same story. Only unrelated independent reporting may resolve chronology, state-directed demand or a simultaneous attendance count.

description: Ten captured French/English searches (including two new follow-ups in this revision) returned mixed-year/noisy results. The original Jan searches included regional prompts for Kayes, Gao, Mopti, Tombouctou and Ségou; follow-ups separately targeted regional outlets and a Bambara/local-language discovery query. The follow-up results did not add a clearly relevant Jan 2023 protest report. Regional media and Bambara/local-language coverage remain incomplete; web search is not a comprehensive archive.
required_followup: If a feasible further pass is authorized, use distinct local/regional outlets and human-reviewed local-language results; do not treat these limited searches as proof no other events occurred.
